payload.content: MCP server debugging for Hermes: when connection fails, (1) increase mcp_discovery_timeout (e.g. 10s for Bun cold start), (2) use `hermes mcp test <name>` to isolate, (3) create wrapper script that sets PATH+env vars before exec, (4) verify with pipe: `echo '{"jsonrpc":"2.0",...}' | ./wrapper`. Also: `path.join` with absolute paths — check startsWith("/") before joining with process.cwd().
